description_en: Queries a list of endpoint groups
kebab_example: aliyun ga list-endpoint-groups --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --accelerator-id ga-bp1odcab8tmno0hdq0000 --region cn-hangzhou
name: ListEndpointGroups

parameters.help_en: The region ID of the Alibaba Cloud Global Accelerator (GA) instance. Set the value to cn-hangzhou
parameters.help_zh: 全球加速实例所在的地域ID，仅取值cn-hangzhou
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en: The page number of the list. Default value: 1
parameters.name: page_number

parameters.help_en: The number of entries per page for a paged query. Maximum value: 50. Default value: 10
parameters.help_zh: 分页查询时每页的行数。最大值：50，默认值：10
parameters.name: page_size

parameters.help_en: The instance ID of the Alibaba Cloud Global Accelerator (GA) instance
parameters.name: accelerator_id

parameters.help_en: The instance ID of the listener
parameters.name: listener_id

parameters.help_en:
The type of the endpoint group. Valid values:

default: default endpoint group.
virtual: virtual endpoint group.
Empty value: queries all default endpoint groups and virtual endpoint groups
parameters.help_zh:
终端节点组类型。取值：

default：默认终端节点组。
virtual：虚拟终端节点组。
空值：表示查询所有默认终端节点组和虚拟终端节点组
parameters.name: endpoint_group_type

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to enable access logging. Valid values:
on: enables access logging.
off (default): disables access logging
parameters.help_zh:
是否开启访问日志。取值：
on：开启访问日志。
off（默认值）：关闭访问日志
parameters.name: access_log_switch

parameters.help_en: The ID of the endpoint group
parameters.name: endpoint_group_id

fields.help_en:
The tag key of the endpoint group.
If you specify this parameter, the value cannot be an empty string.

The tag key can be up to 64 characters in length and cannot start with `aliyun` or `acs:`. It cannot contain `http://` or `https://`.

You can specify up to 20 tag keys
fields.help_zh:
终端节点组的标签键。
一旦输入该值，则不允许为空字符串。

最多支持64个字符，不能以`aliyun`和`acs:`开头，不能包含`http://`或者`https://`。

最多支持输入20个标签键
fields.name: key

fields.help_en:
The tag value of the endpoint group. If you specify this parameter, the value can be an empty string.

The tag value can be up to 128 characters in length and cannot start with `aliyun` or `acs:`. It cannot contain `http://` or `https://`.

You can specify up to 20 tag values
fields.help_zh:
终端节点组的标签值。一旦输入该值，可以为空字符串。

最多支持128个字符，不能以`aliyun`和`acs:`开头，不能包含`http://`或者`https://`。

最多支持输入20个标签值
fields.name: value

parameters.name: tag

EnableClientIPPreservation.description_en:
Indicates whether client IP address preservation is enabled by using the automatic method. Valid values:

true: Client IP address preservation is enabled.

false: Client IP address preservation is disabled

true：开启了保持客户端源 IP 功能。

false：未开启保持客户端源IP功能

EnableProxyProtocol.description_en:
Indicates whether client IP address preservation is enabled by using the ProxyProtocol method. Valid values:

true: Client IP address preservation is enabled by using the ProxyProtocol method.

false: Client IP address preservation is not enabled by using the ProxyProtocol method
EnableProxyProtocol.description_zh:
是否使用ProxyProtocol方式开启了保持客户端源IP功能。

true：使用ProxyProtocol方式开启了保持客户端源IP功能。

false：未使用ProxyProtocol方式开启保持客户端源IP功能

ECS: an Alibaba Cloud ECS instance.

EndpointGroupId.description_en: The ID of the endpoint group

EndpointGroupIpList.description_en:
The list of public IP addresses of the endpoint group.

<notice>
For endpoint groups that use private network back-to-origin, the console displays only private network back-to-origin addresses and no longer displays public IP addresses. If the network connectivity type of the backend service changes (for example, from private network to public network, or to a hybrid of private network and public network back-to-origin), promptly check the changes in back-to-origin addresses and synchronization update the ACL of the backend service accordingly.</notice>
EndpointGroupIpList.description_zh:
终端节点组出公网IP列表。

<notice>
私网回源类型的终端节点组在控制台仅展示私网回源地址，不再展示公网地址。如果终端节点组后端服务的网络连接类型发生变更（例如由私网变更为公网，或调整为公私网混合回源），请及时关注回源地址的变化，并同步更新后端服务的ACL列表。</notice>

items.description_en: The list of public IP addresses of the endpoint group
items.description_zh: 终端节点组出公网IP列表

virtual: a virtual endpoint group

virtual：虚拟终端节点组

EndpointIpVersion.description_en:
The IP protocol version used by the backend service. Valid values:  
IPv4 (default): GA communicates with the endpoint service by using only IPv4 addresses.  
IPv6: GA communicates with the endpoint service by using only IPv6 addresses.  
ProtocolAffinity: The IP protocol used by GA to communicate with the endpoint service is the same as the IP protocol used by the client request
EndpointIpVersion.description_zh:
后端IP地址协议。取值：  
IPv4：（默认值）：GA仅使用IPv4地址与终端节点服务通信。  
IPv6：GA仅使用IPv6地址与终端节点服务通信。  
ProtocolAffinity：GA与终端节点服务通信的IP协议与客户端请求使用的IP协议相同

Name.description_en: The name of the endpoint group

ServiceId.description_en:
The ID of the service that manages the managed instance.

This parameter is valid only when ServiceManaged is set to True
ServiceId.description_zh:
托管实例所属的服务方ID。

仅在ServiceManaged参数为True时有效

ServiceManaged.description_en:
Indicates whether the instance is managed. Valid values:

true: The instance is managed.

false: The instance is not managed
ServiceManaged.description_zh:
是否为托管实例。取值：

true：是托管实例。

false：不是托管实例

ServiceManagedInfos.description_en:
The list of action policies that the user can execute on the managed instance.

This parameter is valid only when ServiceManaged is set to True.
When the instance is managed, user operations on the instance are restricted, and certain actions are prohibited
ServiceManagedInfos.description_zh:
用户在此托管实例下可执行的动作策略列表。

仅在ServiceManaged参数为True时有效。
当实例处于托管状态时，用户对实例的操作会受到限制，某些操作行为会被禁止

items.description_en: The list of action policies that the user can execute on the managed instance
items.description_zh: 用户在此托管实例下可执行的动作策略列表

Action.description_en:
The name of the managed policy action. Valid values:
Create: creates an instance.
Update: updates the current instance.
Delete: deletes the current instance.
Associate: references or is referenced by the current instance.
UserUnmanaged: unmanages the instance.
CreateChild: creates a child resource under the current instance
Action.description_zh:
托管策略动作名称。
Create：创建实例。
Update：更新当前实例。
Delete：删除当前实例。
Associate：引用/被引用当前实例。
UserUnmanaged：用户解托管实例。
CreateChild：在当前实例下创建子资源

ChildType.description_en:
The child resource type. Valid values:
Listener: a listener resource.
IpSet: an acceleration region resource.
EndpointGroup: an endpoint group resource.
ForwardingRule: a forwarding rule resource.
Endpoint: an endpoint resource.
EndpointGroupDestination: a protocol mapping resource for the endpoint group under a custom routing listener.
EndpointPolicy: an endpoint traffic policy resource under a custom routing listener.
This parameter is valid only when Action is set to CreateChild
ChildType.description_zh:
子资源类型。
Listener：监听资源。
IpSet：加速地域资源。
EndpointGroup：终端节点组资源。
ForwardingRule：转发策略资源。
Endpoint：终端节点资源。
EndpointGroupDestination：自定义路由监听下的终端节点组协议映射资源。
EndpointPolicy：自定义路由监听下的终端节点通行策略资源。
仅在Action参数为CreateChild时有效

IsManaged.description_en:
Indicates whether the managed policy action is managed. Valid values:
true: The managed policy action is managed. The user cannot perform the action specified by Action on the managed instance.
false: The managed policy action is not managed. The user can perform the action specified by Action on the managed instance
IsManaged.description_zh:
托管策略动作是否被托管，取值：
true：托管策略动作被托管，用户无权在托管实例下执行Action指定的操作。
false：托管策略动作未被托管，用户可在托管实例下执行Action指定的操作

init: The endpoint group is being initialized.

updating: The endpoint group is being updated.

deleteing: The endpoint group is being deleted

init：初始化。

active：正常。

updating：更新中。

deleteing：删除中
